title: LLM as Detector: An In-context Learning Approach for Tabular Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.19463v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Anomaly detection in tabular data is challenging because abnormal samples often arise as violations of cross-feature dependencies rather than simple marginal deviations. Existing detectors rely on geometric or reconstruction signals, while prior LLM-based approaches mainly fine-tune LLMs with normal samples or generate synthetic anomalies. We propose LLM-Detector, a framework that utilizes the in-context learning capacity of LLMs for structured, prompt-conditioned scoring synthesis, enabling LLMs to derive anomaly detection logic from structured normal-state knowledge. Specifically, normal training data are converted into statistical summaries, causal dependencies, and distilled prototypes that are organized into a prompt for code generation. The resulting scoring engine evaluates statistical deviation, structural inconsistency, and density-based abnormality then computes an anomaly score for each test sample. We evaluate LLM-Detector on

translated_title: 大语言模型作为检测器：一种用于表格数据异常检测的上下文学习方法
translated_abstract: 表格数据中的异常检测具有挑战性，因为异常样本通常表现为跨特征依赖关系的违反，而非简单的边缘偏差。现有检测器依赖几何或重构信号，而先前基于大语言模型的方法主要使用正常样本微调大语言模型或生成合成异常。我们提出LLM-Detector，一个利用大语言模型上下文学习能力进行结构化、提示条件化评分合成的框架，使大语言模型能够从结构化正常状态知识中推导异常检测逻辑。具体而言，正常训练数据被转换为统计摘要、因果依赖和蒸馏原型，并组织成用于代码生成的提示。生成的评分引擎评估统计偏差、结构不一致性和基于密度的异常性，然后为每个测试样本计算异常分数。我们在...
tldr: 本文提出LLM-Detector框架，利用大语言模型的上下文学习能力，通过将正常数据转换为统计摘要、因果依赖和原型提示来生成评分代码，实现无需微调的表格数据异常检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLM-Detector, a framework that leverages LLM in-context learning to generate scoring code from statistical summaries, causal dependencies, and prototypes of normal data, enabling fine-tuning-free anomaly detection in tabular data.
